actions.action: Keep the wound dry for 5-7 days (shelter from rain and sprinklers)
Glance at the hole daily to check healing
Post an update if the wound turns soft, black or oozes
Cap spine tips touching neighboring leaves with cork or pencil eraser
Plant in gritty, fast-draining spot amended with gravel or pumice
Water only once top few inches of soil are dry
Gradually acclimate to full sun over about 2 weeks
